evidence: PDF full-text excerpts with preserved table layout; title and abstract

outcome_definitions.beaten: The authors' proposed method clearly outperforms this baseline on the principal reported evaluation. Require model-specific evidence; generic state-of-the-art claims are insufficient.
outcome_definitions.mixed: The proposed method beats this baseline on some reported tasks, settings, or principal metrics and loses on others, or an explicit performance/efficiency tradeoff prevents an overall winner.
outcome_definitions.tied: The principal comparison explicitly reports comparable or tied performance, with no clear overall winner. Similar-looking numbers alone do not establish a tie.
outcome_definitions.baseline_wins: This baseline clearly outperforms the authors' proposed method on the principal reported evaluation.
outcome_definitions.unclear: The model is an experimental baseline, but excerpts omit decisive results, the tables cannot be read reliably, or the evidence does not establish the direction of the comparison.
outcome_definitions.no_proposed_method: The model is directly evaluated in a benchmark, survey, or diagnostic with no new proposed method to beat it.
outcome_definitions.not_baseline: The model is cited, discussed, used only as a backbone or component, or its performance is copied from another work without running it as an experimental comparator in this paper.

source_audit.reviewer: Codex agent source-text review; not a human review or independent replication
source_audit.limitation: A small stratified spot check is not an estimate of corpus-wide accuracy. Unresolved provenance remains excluded.

limitations: Jev judgments from excerpts; some tables and supplementary results may be incomplete.
Results reflect authors' reported comparisons, not independent replication or statistical significance.
Only tracked robotics models are included. A backbone is not automatically a baseline.
Mixed results retain tradeoffs. Uncertain baseline roles are excluded from evaluation counts.
Months use first submission; later revisions can discuss later model releases.
